    static int solve(int vCount, int kCount, int sCount, int lastUsed) {
        if (vCount == totalV && kCount == totalK && sCount == totalS) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (memo[vCount][kCount][sCount][lastUsed] != -1) {
            return memo[vCount][kCount][sCount][lastUsed];
        }
        int minCost = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        if (vCount < totalV) {
            int positionIndex = positions[0].get(vCount);
            int moveCost = Math.max(frequency[positionIndex][0] - vCount, 0)
                         + Math.max(frequency[positionIndex][1] - kCount, 0)
                         + Math.max(frequency[positionIndex][2] - sCount, 0) - 1;
            minCost = Math.min(minCost, solve(vCount + 1, kCount, sCount, 0) + moveCost);
        }
        if (kCount < totalK && lastUsed != 0) {
            int positionIndex = positions[1].get(kCount);
            int moveCost = Math.max(frequency[positionIndex][0] - vCount, 0)
                         + Math.max(frequency[positionIndex][1] - kCount, 0)
                         + Math.max(frequency[positionIndex][2] - sCount, 0) - 1;
            minCost = Math.min(minCost, solve(vCount, kCount + 1, sCount, 1) + moveCost);
        }
        if (sCount < totalS) {
            int positionIndex = positions[2].get(sCount);

        return memo[vCount][kCount][sCount][lastUsed] = minCost;
